title: 60-minute smoke and consistency audit
purpose: User-requested bounded code/smoke/functional consistency assessment; does not supersede prior industry campaign or assert full product release acceptance.
global_rules: Never test the product database or product stack.
Collect all round results before repairs.

test_cases.title: Full isolated backend regression
test_cases.input: All collected backend tests finish with no failures; skips explicitly assessed.
completion_criteria: All collected backend tests finish with no failures; skips explicitly assessed.

test_cases.title: Full frontend regression
test_cases.input: All frontend library and agent tests pass.
completion_criteria: All frontend library and agent tests pass.

test_cases.title: Registered endpoint smoke
test_cases.input: All registered backend and frontend method bindings dispatch without 5xx, 405, timeout or connection failure on the isolated stack.
completion_criteria: All registered backend and frontend method bindings dispatch without 5xx, 405, timeout or connection failure on the isolated stack.

test_cases.title: Browser functional continuity
test_cases.input: All existing Playwright cases pass with actual persistence, workflow and trace assertions; blocked or skipped cases prevent full success.
completion_criteria: All existing Playwright cases pass with actual persistence, workflow and trace assertions; blocked or skipped cases prevent full success.

test_cases.title: HTTP end-to-end workflow
test_cases.input: Small and large real workflow acceptance pass with persisted model, simulation and complete scope evidence.
completion_criteria: Small and large real workflow acceptance pass with persisted model, simulation and complete scope evidence.

test_cases.title: Code and contract consistency review
test_cases.input: Review current source, test coverage and runtime results for reproducible function continuity defects; unresolved findings remain failures.
completion_criteria: Review current source, test coverage and runtime results for reproducible function continuity defects; unresolved findings remain failures.
